rationale: Re-themes about 150 to 200 files from Graphite back to Folio, with Graphite-to-Folio mappings for components that never existed in Folio, and deletes the release workflow docker-publish.yml, which changes release machinery.

signals.blast_radius: About 150 to 200 files across src/components, src/app, tests, the guards, DESIGN_SYSTEM.md, the Dockerfile and entrypoint, CI workflows, compose and the E2E DB scripts, and the docs
signals.unresolved: Open question 1 (restore folio.ts x3 or keep the 021 atoms.ts and classes.ts structure) changes the file list, and the 023-031 UI has no Folio reference to restyle against
signals.irreversibility: Git-revertible in principle, but it is a large re-theme with many UI and a11y tests asserting on styling, and deleting the deploy workflow plus the port and compose-project change alter how the fork is built and run
